numeric_complexity_contract.reference: sort a copy and compare it with range(n)
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: cyclic placement on a private copy: swap each in-range value into its own index; a value outside 0..n-1 or a second copy of a value already in place means false
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(n) time/O(n) space for the copy (O(1) beyond it)

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: try every offset, cut the sequence into pieces and test each piece with a set
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: for each pair of consecutive equal plays at positions j < i with i - j < numSongs, the cut must fall in j+1..i, an arc of residues mod numSongs; add each arc to a difference array and accept when some residue is covered by every arc
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(L + numSongs) time/O(L + numSongs) space

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: sort every window and sum all but its k largest values
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: two lazy-deletion heaps: a min-heap holding the k largest (value, index) entries of the window and a max-heap with the rest; a location array marks which heap owns each live index and running sums give each average in O(1)
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(n log n) time/O(n) space
